inputs.synth: --decks synth_roles, random leaders, seeds 0..999 both seats = 2,000 decks
inputs.real: --decks user (tests/fixtures/decks/user_decks_20260728.json, 4 decks, holdout; only aggregate quantities used)

files: opcg_sim/loop/record_gen.py, arena_shard.py, gate.py, tests/scripts/t18_arena.py, tests/scripts/theory_trace.py (--decks choice synth_roles2; defaults unchanged)
tests/test_deck_synth2.py (new: 1 test, v2 builds legal decks)

notes: Real decks are only 4; v2 rules are ranges (distinct 14-16, 4-ofs 7-10, high-cost 6-16 cards) rather than the real values. The cost-3 penalty (score -2) is the one rule taken from the 4-deck observation (cost-3 counts 0/0/0/3); overfit risk noted.
No real-deck card or card combination is used by the generator (holdout rule); only aggregate quantities from the comparison table guided the rules.
Vanilla cards stay excluded (user decision 2026-08-15) although one real deck runs 4.
Removal amount uses the same rate draw as deck_roles (0-25%) and is not tuned to real decks (removal 15.7 vs real 20.3); it is the contrast design of §20.8.1.
synth_deck's base deck is seed-independent (rng only shuffles): 1 distinct base per leader. v2 adds score noise so each seed gives a different deck.
check_legal counts copies by card number (official rule); the generators count by name (stricter). Real decks with same-name different-number cards and the 'any number' card (OP16-042 x8) pass.
docs/leader_specs/ holds per-set leader effect specs, no deck-construction norms, so nothing was added from there.
Defaults unchanged; whether waves 48+ use synth_roles2 (and the arena main condition that goes with it) is left to the coordinator/user (report §8).
